Intel: Python code with syntax errors should report diagnostics

```rust title="Rust"
use tree_sitter_language_pack::process;

fn main() {
    let source = r#"def broken(
    pass
"#;
    let config_json: serde_json::Value = serde_json::from_str(r#"{"diagnostics":true,"language":"python"}"#).unwrap();
    let config = serde_json::from_value(config_json).unwrap();
    let _ = process(source, &config);
    println!("{:?}", result.language);
    println!("{:?}", result.metrics.error_count);
    println!("{:?}", result.diagnostics);
}
```
